subject: Request: backfill + band uplift for Applied ML (internal transfer)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: backfill + band uplift for Applied ML (internal transfer)

Hi all,

Quick note to request approval to backfill the Applied ML engineer who moved to Product ML last week (internal transfer). The role we need to refill is the "Applied ML Engineer (Sr)" on Infra-ML team, but after reviewing the scope we think the bar has shifted and would like to request a band uplift from IC3 -> IC4 for this hire.

Rationale (short):
- The vacancy will own low-latency model serving integrations (kernel-level optimization work) and a cross-org oncall rotation.
- We will actively recruit candidates with prior production inference experience; market comps indicate the IC4 band is a better fit to secure the needed profile.
- Replacing at IC3 will create churn risk for the current roadmap (quantization kernel work + rollout deadlines).

Asks:
1) Approve reclassifying the open headcount to IC4 (title: Sr Applied ML Eng).
2) Allow offer up to 15% above midpoint for competitive offers (we will share comps).
3) Engage GreenTree (recruiter) and CompAssess for a short band analysis.

Attachments: JD draft (jd-applied-ml-sr-v2.pdf), preliminary comp analysis (comp-band-analysis-2025.xlsx).

Happy to jump on a quick 15 if you want to talk details.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Engineering Manager, ML Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: backfill + band uplift for Applied ML (internal transfer)

Neha — thanks for the context and the doc. A couple quick Qs:

1) Do we have budget headroom in this quarter for an IC4 hire? If not, can we offset by pausing one of the open infra contractor lines?
2) Can you share two recent candidate comps (name redacted) or market snapshots so I can sign off on the uplift percentage?

If you think this is time-sensitive I can route an approval to Finance and flag as expedited. Otherwise would like to see the CompAssess note before approving >10% above midpoint.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: backfill + band uplift for Applied ML (internal transfer)

Agree with Neha that the scope justifies stronger seniority. Approving in principle subject to the following:
- Laura: Finance OK for up to 12% above midpoint. Anything >12% needs an exec exception.
- Neha: please confirm the specific hiring manager and the role's oncall expectations in the JD (I want it explicit).

If you can get CompAssess to deliver their short report by Monday we can fast-track.

-Markus

Head of Engineering Operations

Key finding: the IC4 midpoint sits ~10% above the current IC3 midpoint; to be competitive for production inference hires we recommend offering between midpoint and +12% depending on experience.

Thanks everyone —

Summary and next steps based on approvals:
- Laura: Finance OK for expedited review up to 12% above midpoint (we will route final sign-off if comp >12%).
- Markus: noted; JD updated to call out 1:8 oncall and ownership of quantization kernels (attached new JD).
- GreenTree: please schedule first screen with Alex for Tues/Wed next week; target base up to $195k (aligns with CompAssess).

Marissa / HR: please convert the open headcount REQ-4512 to IC4 and prepare an expedited offer packet. I will provide the final offer amount if the loop goes >12%.

Forwarding to HR-ticket (HR-2025-1147) and attaching updated JD and candidate resume.
